covered.rule: §1 State every product, amount and days late before asking
§2 At most three holder asks; NO-CONTACT/NOT-CLEAR
§2 do not say arrears, balance, commitment or facility
§3 three questions in order, formats, MONTH/DAY/YEAR
§3 refusal explained once, ID-STOP/NO-CHECK; asking why is not refusal
§4 callback next business day 08:10–11:40, after now, one alternate
§5 next weekday = following week; ask for missing month/year
§5 today eligible, roll forward if eligible, after deadline offer deadline, vague once, no eligible date -> DECLINE
§6 four bands with deadlines and attempts
§7 floors per type, floor once, floor wording, floor..full
§8 confirm phrase, retry TWICE, one promise per product, receipt sentence, change reply
§9 already paid / dispute / hardship / restructuring / human / scam / refuse
§10 notes on non-transfer calls, reasons, none on transfer
